name: Glissa
description: A compleated elf who serves Vorinclex.

description_citations.text: "Vorinclex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa Sunseeker declares she will unlock the secret at the heart of Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: There's a secret at the heart of this world, and I will unlock it.

citation.text: Glissa Sunseeker (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glissa says someone is defying the gods and shaping the planet, and she intends to stop it.
timeline.quote: Someone or something is defying the power of the gods and shaping this planet. I intend for it to stop.

citation.text: Tempest of Light (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glissa is amazed at the darkness of Mephidross.
timeline.quote: I would never have believed that on a world with four suns there could exist a place so dark.

citation.text: Dross Prowler (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bosh searches for the secrets of his past while Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch.
timeline.quote: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

citation.text: Bosh, Iron Golem (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glissa Sunseeker recalls Slobad as seemingly exiled for being too smart.
timeline.quote: I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart.

citation.text: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glissa responds with a wedgie from beyond Uranus.
timeline.quote: Ever the warrior, Glissa responded with a "wedgie from beyond Uranus."

citation.text: Wet Willie of the Damned (Unhinged, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the center of the maze they find Vorinclex sparring joyfully with Glissa.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex fought a Phyrexian elf beneath the monstrous skulls that hung from the ceiling.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka charges in against Glissa while Nissa fights Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: Without another word, Lukka charged in.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Glissa takes command of Lukka, ordering him to find but not kill Nissa, and Lukka sets out hunting.
timeline.quote: Find the elf, Lukka. But do not kill her.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Memnarch takes control of the Kaldra avatar and turns it against Glissa.
timeline.quote: he took control of the avatar and turned it against her.

citation.text: "Avatar", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bruenna agrees to help Glissa, Slobad and Bosh reach the Pool of Knowledge.
timeline.quote: she agreed to assist them, motivated by the opportunity to undermine the Vedalken

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bruenna and Glissa are captured by Lord Pontifex, escape, and survive a confrontation with Janus.
timeline.quote: She was later captured with Glissa by Lord Pontifex

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bruenna unites the races of Mirrodin with Glissa and Lyese against Memnarch.
timeline.quote: Bruenna was instrumental in bridging alliances between elves, leonin, goblins, and others.

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bruenna is captured by Yert in the Mephidross and hooked into a stasis machine; Glissa frees her but is locked in stasis for five years.
timeline.quote: There she was captured by Yert

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bruenna loses a hand in the war and later frees Glissa from stasis.
timeline.quote: Bruenna lost a hand during the war with Memnarch

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chunth entrusts Glissa with the secret that the world is hollow before a traitor kills him.
timeline.quote: This is the secret that Chunth , the Tel-Jilad troll elder, entrusts to Glissa before his death at the hands of a traitor.

citation.text: "Darksteel", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa fights through Lumengrid and down into the Pool of Knowledge, whose lacuna leads to Mirrodin's interior.
timeline.quote: Glissa fights her way through the great vedalken capital of Lumengrid , down into the Pool of Knowledge .

citation.text: "Darksteel", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fleeing her vedalken pursuers, Glissa discovers that Memnarch is real and waits for her.
timeline.quote: Memnarch is real, and he patiently waits for the elvish champion to find him.

citation.text: "Darksteel", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Many elves are compleated and join the Vicious Swarm.
timeline.quote: many elves have been compleated by the glistening oil and become a part of the Phyrexian faction, the Vicious Swarm

citation.text: "Elf", section "Phyrexian Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa, Bosh and Slobad journey to Mirrodin's core with the Kaldra avatar to confront Memnarch.
timeline.quote: journey deep within Mirrodin's core to confront the insidious Memnarch

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch seizes the Kaldra avatar with a single spell and turns it on Glissa and her companions.
timeline.quote: Memnarch seizes the avatar with a single spell and turns it on Glissa and her companions.

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The avatar pursues Glissa into the Tangle, destroying everything in its way.
timeline.quote: Kaldra's avatar relentlessly pursues Glissa into the Tangle

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Radix, Glissa's body calls forth a column of green mana from Mirrodin's core that annihilates the avatar.
timeline.quote: Glissa's body calls forth a great column of green mana from Mirrodin's core, annihilating the avatar in the process.

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The green mana hangs overhead as a glowing sphere, the green sun and Mirrodin's fifth dawn.
timeline.quote: the green sun at last, Mirrodin's fifth dawn

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa, Slobad and Bosh resist Memnarch and confront him in the Core, where he channels the plane's mana through the Panopticon.
timeline.quote: Their resistance culminated in a confrontation deep within Mirrodin's Core

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch turns Kaldra against them, and Glissa and Slobad flee to the Tangle and arrive at the Radix.
timeline.quote: Forced to retreat, Glissa and Slobad fled to the Tangle

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Believing Slobad dead, Glissa triggers a surge of green mana that destroys Kaldra and births the green sun, the Fifth Dawn.
timeline.quote: annihilated Kaldra, and shot into the sky, birthing a new sun

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad are captured by Viridian elves who blame Glissa for vanishing kin.
timeline.quote: Glissa and Slobad were captured by Viridian elves

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa slaughters Yert's Reaper and wins his help; Geth's vampire attacks her and she defeats it, forcing Geth to tell her what she wanted.
timeline.quote: Geth told Glissa what she wanted to know which got her to leave more quickly

citation.text: "Geth", section "The Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Trolls abduct Glissa, and Chunth says it was to protect her; she flees and learns the trolls were truthful.
timeline.quote: This troll called himself Chunth and explained that they had taken her to protect her.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa finds her home a charnel house, is wounded and captured by levelers, and is freed by Slobad.
timeline.quote: she found it a charnel house with levelers milling about.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa befriends Kha Raksha at Taj-Nar and travels through the Mephidross with Slobad and Bosh, defeating Geth.
timeline.quote: After defeating him, she struck a deal to spare him for information

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Lumengrid Glissa kills Pontifex, only to have the true culprit revealed.
timeline.quote: she managed to kill him... only to have the true culprit revealed.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa learns Memnarch is responsible, wields the Kaldra artifacts and is betrayed when Memnarch controls the Kaldra Champion; she escapes as the Fifth Dawn erupts.
timeline.quote: It was revealed that her latent planeswalker's spark was Memnarch's final goal

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa is arrested for her parents' murder, cleared when levelers attack her trial, and learns her sister Lyese lives.
timeline.quote: As it turned out, her sister Lyese had not perished during the attack.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa is trapped in a time-bubble for five years, then dives to the core and finds Memnarch's spark-transfer machine with a tortured Slobad.
timeline.quote: she found Slobad strapped to the machine, horribly tortured, and used to engineer it.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa knocks Memnarch into the core; her spark transfers to Slobad, who relinquishes it, triggering the Vanishing.
timeline.quote: Slobad willingly relinquished his newfound spark and powers to save his friend, Glissa

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn leaves Glissa, Slobad and Geth as the new guardians of Mirrodin and the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Karn left Glissa, Slobad, and Geth as the new guardians of Argentum (Mirrodin) and the Mirari .

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves accuse Glissa of the damage done, calling her Glissa the Traitor; she is eventually corrupted and compleated by Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: Compleated by Vorinclex , she became the champion of the praetor

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Mirrodin Besieged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa becomes Vorinclex's steward and commander of much of the Vicious Swarm, helping design the Hunter Maze.
timeline.quote: leaving Glissa as his steward to handle long-term matters and other factions.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Phyrexia: All Will be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lukka and Nissa encounter Glissa in the Hunter Maze; Lukka is compleated and joins her against Nissa.
timeline.quote: Lukka was compleated and joined her in the fight against Nissa.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Phyrexia: All Will be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Locked out of Mirrodin, Karn sends dreams to Glissa; after Memnarch falls he turns him back into the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Karn turned Memnarch back into the Mirari and left it in the care of Glissa, Slobad , and Geth .

citation.text: "Karn", section "Argentum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn flees to Mirrodin as the oil takes hold, later worshipped as Father of Machines and trapped in his own mind as Mirrodin becomes New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Karn retreated to Mirrodin's Core , being worshipped as the new Father of Machines

citation.text: "Karn", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lukka is compleated, fully merging with his companion, and Glissa orders him to capture Nissa alive.
timeline.quote: By the time he fought Glissa and Vorinclex , he fully bonded with his companion and the two became one.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch finds Glissa and becomes obsessed with stealing her spark; she escapes his agents repeatedly.
timeline.quote: becoming obsessed with capturing her and stealing her spark for himself.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa confronts Memnarch with the Kaldra champion; he seizes control of it, Bosh sacrifices himself, and the mana core destabilizes, giving birth to the Green Sun.
timeline.quote: The only thing that saved her was the sacrifice of her close friend Bosh .

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch turns to brute force, trapping Glissa in a temporal bubble for five years and altering his devices to use souls as power.
timeline.quote: Memnarch trapped her for five years in a temporal bubble.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa wakes, rallies survivors and assaults Memnarch's stronghold, throwing herself at him as the spark device activates so both fall into the mana core.
timeline.quote: together, they both fell into the raw mana core of Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn restores the souls, causing the Vanishing, destroys Memnarch's body and gives the Mirari to Glissa, Slobad and Geth.
timeline.quote: Karn destroyed Memnarch's body, recovering the Mirari

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Memnarch's defeat Karn melts him down, revealing the Mirari, left in the care of Glissa, Slobad and Geth.
timeline.quote: Karn returned to his plane and melted down Memnarch to his core, revealing the Mirari underneath.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch kidnaps countless beings from other planes before the elf Glissa Sunseeker defeats him.
timeline.quote: He kidnapped countless beings from other planes before he was finally defeated by the elf Glissa Sunseeker.

citation.text: "Mirrodin". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glissa begins her story, setting out to find out why the levelers seek to destroy her, which starts to uncover the mysteries of Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: begins her story to find out why the monstrous "levelers" seek to destroy her

citation.text: "Mirrodin", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa's mana destroys Kaldra's avatar and becomes the fifth sun.
timeline.quote: Glissa's body called forth a great torrent of green mana

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "The Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa kills Memnarch, destroying the soul traps.
timeline.quote: When Glissa eventually killed Memnarch, all the existing soul traps on the plane were destroyed, killing everyone instantly

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "The Vanishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Hunter Maze Lukka fuses with Rothga and is fully compleated after fighting Vorinclex and Glissa.
timeline.quote: Lukka fusing with Rothga, fully compleating him

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Slobad builds the Ascension Web for Memnarch; at the Vanishing the Panopticon is annihilated.
timeline.quote: Upon the Vanishing , the main structure of the Panopticon, as well as its reconstruction disk, was annihilated.

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad defeat Memnarch in Mirrodin's Core, triggering the Vanishing.
timeline.quote: The Fifth Dawn event would lead Glissa and Slobad to defeat Memnarch in Mirrodin's Core

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Creation and Corruption of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geth reports to Glissa and the mad Karn, and Glissa sends Tezzeret to bring Elspeth to her.
timeline.quote: Karn has gone mad and keeps dripping glistening oil

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After killing her tormenters, Tezzeret reveals that Melira is immune to phyresis and wants her in the resistance's hands, defying Glissa.
timeline.quote: This act of defying the wishes of Glissa

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret betrays Glissa as she attacks with Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: is suddenly stopped by a surprise betrayal by Tezzeret

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Slobad helps the captured elf Glissa free herself and leads her to Taj-Nar to be healed.
timeline.quote: Slobad leads her back to Taj-Nar where the leonin could heal her wounds.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Slobad repairs the golem Bosh, who joins Glissa and Slobad.
timeline.quote: introduced himself as Bosh

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group defeats the necromancer Geth at Ish Sah.
timeline.quote: ruled by the necromancer Geth

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa kills Pontifex, who was orchestrating the attacks.
timeline.quote: Glissa confronted the mysterious individual orchestrating the attacks

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group learns Memnarch is responsible for the attacks.
timeline.quote: The ancient and mythical being known as Memnarch was responsible for the attacks.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kaldra avatar betrays the group when Memnarch takes control of it.
timeline.quote: they were betrayed by the avatar when Memnarch gained control of it.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bosh stays behind and gives his life so his friends can escape.
timeline.quote: Bosh stayed behind while the pair escaped, giving his life to spare his friends.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Fifth Dawn is triggered and a new green sun is born.
timeline.quote: The Fifth Dawn was triggered, blasting the Kaldra Guardian away

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Viridian Elves arrest Glissa and Slobad for the murder of Glissa's parents.
timeline.quote: were immediately arrested by the Viridian Elves for the murder of Glissa's parents

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa falls into a trap at Ish-Sah, leaving Slobad alone.
timeline.quote: Glissa fell into a horrible trap

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa knocks herself and Memnarch into the core and her spark transfers to Slobad.
timeline.quote: her spark was accidentally transferred to his battered form

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Mirrodin Tezzeret infiltrates the Phyrexian hierarchy, immune to phyresis, rising to sit beside Karn.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret established himself within the Phyrexian hierarchy without the compromise of undergoing compleation

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret fights Glissa while plotting to usurp Karn's throne; the outcome is unknown.
timeline.quote: This resulted in direct combat with Glissa

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch learns the vedalken are chasing the elf Glissa and sends Malil to retrieve her.
timeline.quote: He sends Malil, who has been made in Memnarch’s original image, to retrieve her.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cornered by Malil's threshers and levelers, Glissa channels green fire in an explosive burst that disables all pursuers.
timeline.quote: In a rage at what appears to be the end, Glissa channels her green fire again into an explosive burst that disables all their pursuers.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "In the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch rebuffs Pontifex's offer to become part of him, and Pontifex blames Glissa and begins going insane.
timeline.quote: He interprets this as Glissa being responsible for his god abandoning him, and starts going insane.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Pontifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bosh barrels through vedalken attackers, and the group learns the Mycosynth is infecting Bosh.
timeline.quote: To get past, Bosh rolls into a ball and barrels through the attackers.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Pontifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sapient wolf Al-Hayat joins the group and helps rescue Slobad.
timeline.quote: He agrees to join the group, and together they rescue Slobad.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Meeting Al-Hayat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pontifex tries to kill Orland and orders Glissa's death, testing Marek's loyalty, until Bruenna arrives with Neurok wizards.
timeline.quote: Pontifex attempts to kill Orland, and when he orders Glissa’s death, Marek’s loyalty is tested.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Attacks on the band". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The nim attack the levelers, letting Glissa's group slip away from Malil.
timeline.quote: the nim also begin attacking the levelers, much to Malil’s chagrin

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Attacks on the band". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch's plan is revealed: he will use the green sun's power and Glissa's spark to become a planeswalker, as Mirrodin comes undone.
timeline.quote: He has built the Panopticon on the exact spot the green sun will emerge from to use its power and turn himself into a planeswalker .

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Memnarch's plan revealed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa's group reaches Geth's throne room in the Vault of Whispers, where Geth welcomes them menacingly and springs a trap.
timeline.quote: Once inside, Geth enters and welcomes them menacingly.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "The Vault of Whispers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marek captures Glissa, but a standoff between Pontifex and Malil lets her escape and find the Kaldra shield.
timeline.quote: Glissa is taken captive by Marek, but Malil suddenly arrives with levelers in tow.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "The Vault of Whispers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa emerges in the arm of the Kaldra Champion, slaughtering many vedalken, then destroys every leveler and weapon in rage as Al-Hayat dies.
timeline.quote: It slaughters many of the Vedalken, and those left beat a hasty retreat.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "The Kaldra avatar emerges". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bruenna and Glissa are devoured by threshers in the core.
timeline.quote: Bruenna is swallowed whole by one

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Glissa versus Pontifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marek saves Glissa from Pontifex, and Pontifex and Marek kill one another.
timeline.quote: Pontifex and Marek end up killing one another, leaving Glissa free.
